name: Retail & E-commerce
headline: Margin now runs through your data.
heroTagline: Generative search is quietly rewriting how customers discover products, agents are starting to run the aisles, and retail media — built entirely on first-party data — has become the industry’s fastest-growing profit line. The winners are no longer the biggest catalogs; they are the ones that turn every click, basket and return into margin. We help retailers unify their data and put AI to work on the decisions that move the P&L: demand, price, personalization and service.
statement: Every margin point in retail now runs through data.
intro: From demand forecasting and dynamic pricing to personalization and agent-assisted service, we help retailers turn first-party data into the margin and loyalty advantages the market no longer gives away.

challenges.title: Demand & inventory intelligence
challenges.body: ML forecasting across stores, channels and SKUs that cuts stockouts and markdowns at the same time — fed by clean, governed data pipelines.

challenges.title: Personalization at scale
challenges.body: Recommendation and next-best-action systems built on real-time customer data platforms, measured on incremental revenue, not clicks.

challenges.title: Agent-assisted commerce & service
challenges.body: AI agents for conversational shopping, order operations and service recovery — with guardrails that protect brand and margin.

challenges.title: Supply chain visibility
challenges.body: Streaming data platforms that give planners a live, trusted view from supplier to shelf.

outcomes.title: Markdown reduction for an omnichannel apparel retailer
outcomes.body: Rebuilt demand forecasting on a lakehouse foundation with SKU-store level ML models; markdowns fell 23% in two seasons while availability improved.

outcomes.title: Revenue per session from personalization
outcomes.body: A governed customer data platform plus real-time recommendations lifted revenue per session 12% — with full consent lineage for privacy teams.

useCases.title: Agentic shopping assistants
useCases.body: Conversational AI that guides discovery, answers product questions and completes purchases — the Rufus-style assistant is becoming table stakes for large catalogs.
useCases.whyNow: Generative search is resetting how customers find products; retailers without an assistant lose the conversation entirely.

useCases.title: Autonomous replenishment & allocation
useCases.body: Agents that turn forecasts into draft transfer, reorder and allocation decisions for planner approval — closing the loop between prediction and action.
useCases.whyNow: Planner teams are shrinking while SKU counts grow; prediction without execution leaves the value on the table.
useCases.impact: Hours of planner time returned daily

useCases.title: Markdown & dynamic pricing optimization
useCases.body: SKU-store level price and markdown optimization that protects margin in volatile demand — the fastest payback program in most retail portfolios.
useCases.whyNow: Persistent cost pressure and demand volatility make static pricing calendars an annual write-off.

useCases.title: Retail media data foundations
useCases.body: Clean-room-ready first-party data products that power the retail media business — audiences, measurement and closed-loop attribution advertisers will pay for.
useCases.whyNow: Retail media is the industry's fastest-growing profit pool, and it runs entirely on governed customer data.

useCases.title: Computer-vision shrink & shelf intelligence
useCases.body: Vision models on existing camera estates for loss prevention, on-shelf availability and planogram compliance.
useCases.whyNow: Shrink hit historic highs post-pandemic while shelf-edge labor keeps getting scarcer.

faqs.q: Where should a retailer start with AI if margins are tight?
faqs.a: Start where margin leaks fastest: SKU-store forecasting and markdown optimization. They pay back inside a season, fund the roadmap, and force the product and inventory data cleanup every later initiative depends on.

faqs.q: Can you work with our existing commerce and ERP stack?
faqs.a: Yes. We integrate with the major commerce, ERP and POS platforms rather than replacing them — the intelligence layer reads from and writes back to the systems your operations already run on.

faqs.q: How do you handle customer data privacy in personalization?
faqs.a: Consent-aware customer data platforms with lineage on every attribute, so personalization and retail media run on data you can defend — to regulators and to customers. Privacy engineering is part of the build, not a review at the end.

name: Banking & Financial Services
headline: Automate boldly. Prove every decision.
heroTagline: Payments have gone instant, fraud now moves in milliseconds, and agentic operations are compressing cost centers that stood for decades — all under the unblinking gaze of model risk and the regulator. The next efficiency wave belongs to the banks that can automate boldly and prove every decision. We build the governed data platforms, explainable models and audit-ready agentic workflows that let financial institutions move fast without moving off-side.
statement: In banking, the constraint is not ambition — it is auditability.
intro: We build data platforms, AI models and agentic workflows that satisfy model risk management and regulators by design — so banks can automate boldly without ever losing the audit trail.

challenges.title: Risk & regulatory reporting
challenges.body: Governed data platforms with full lineage that turn BCBS 239-style reporting from a fire drill into a pipeline.

challenges.title: Financial crime & fraud
challenges.body: Real-time detection models with explainability and case-management workflows that cut false positives without missing the real thing.

challenges.title: Governed agentic automation
challenges.body: AI agents for KYC refresh, dispute handling and operations — every action policy-checked, logged and reviewable, aligned with model risk expectations.

challenges.title: Customer intelligence
challenges.body: Next-best-conversation analytics for relationship managers and digital channels, built on consented, governed data.

outcomes.title: False-positive reduction in transaction monitoring
outcomes.body: Replaced rule-only screening with a hybrid ML approach and evaluation harness; analyst workload fell 40% with improved detection coverage — documented for model validation.

outcomes.title: Faster KYC periodic reviews with governed agents

useCases.body: Agents that assemble evidence, screen media, draft risk assessments and route to human approvers — with every step logged for the second line.

useCases.title: Relationship manager copilots
useCases.body: GenAI briefs that synthesize portfolios, market moves and CRM history into next-best-conversation preparation for bankers.
useCases.whyNow: The productivity gap between AI-equipped and unequipped RMs is now visible in wallet share.

useCases.title: Real-time fraud & scam defense
useCases.body: Behavioral and network models that catch authorized-push-payment scams and mule activity as payments go instant.
useCases.whyNow: Instant payment rails compress the fraud decision window to milliseconds — batch screening is structurally too late.
useCases.impact: -40% false positives at higher catch rates

useCases.title: Explainable credit underwriting
useCases.body: ML underwriting with reason codes, bias monitoring and full documentation — built for EU AI Act high-risk obligations and fair-lending scrutiny.
useCases.whyNow: Credit scoring is explicitly high-risk under the EU AI Act, with obligations now in application.
useCases.impact: More approvals at equal risk, audit-ready

useCases.title: Regulatory reporting pipelines
useCases.body: Lineage-complete data platforms that assemble BCBS 239-style risk and finance reports as governed pipelines, not quarterly heroics.
useCases.whyNow: Supervisors are probing data lineage directly; manual assembly is now itself a finding.

faqs.q: Will your AI systems pass our model risk management review?
faqs.a: They are designed for it: documented development evidence, evaluation harnesses, monitoring, explainability appropriate to the model class, and complete decision logs. We work with your second line from the first sprint, not the last.

faqs.q: How do you deploy agents in a regulated environment?
faqs.a: Graduated autonomy under a policy engine: propose-only until reliability is proven, approval-free execution earned per action class, hard stops on irreversible actions permanently. Every action is policy-checked and logged as a book of record.

faqs.q: Can you work within our on-premise and data residency constraints?
faqs.a: Yes. Our architectures deploy in your cloud tenancy or on-premise estate, respect data residency boundaries, and use models available within your approved perimeter — including private model deployments where required.

name: Insurance
headline: Underwriting is a data business now.
heroTagline: Document intelligence is digitizing the submission desk, climate volatility is repricing entire books overnight, and the moat is shifting from actuarial tables to data pipelines. Underwriting, claims and service are becoming, at their core, data disciplines. We help insurers modernize that core — pricing risk sharper, settling claims faster, and keeping every model defensible under regulatory and fair-lending scrutiny.
statement: Underwriting is a data business wearing a paper costume.
intro: We help insurers digitize the core — underwriting, claims and service — with data platforms and AI that price risk sharper, settle claims faster and keep every decision explainable to regulators and reinsurers.

challenges.title: Underwriting intelligence
challenges.body: Risk models enriched with third-party and geospatial data, delivered into underwriter workbenches that explain every recommendation.

challenges.title: Claims automation
challenges.body: Straight-through processing for clean claims and AI-assisted adjudication for the rest — with fraud signals and human escalation built in.

challenges.title: Document intelligence
challenges.body: LLM-powered extraction from submissions, medical records and loss runs that turns unstructured paper into structured, auditable data.

challenges.title: Portfolio & cat analytics
challenges.body: Exposure and accumulation analytics on modern lakehouse foundations, ready for climate-driven scrutiny.

outcomes.title: Submission triage time for a commercial insurer
outcomes.body: Document-intelligence pipelines extract and normalize submission data; underwriters start with a structured risk picture instead of a PDF pile.

outcomes.title: Average claims cycle reduced from 11 days
outcomes.body: Straight-through processing for low-complexity claims and agent-assisted adjudication elsewhere — customer satisfaction up double digits.

useCases.title: Submission intake & triage
useCases.body: Document intelligence that reads broker submissions, loss runs and schedules, normalizes them and prioritizes the book for underwriters.
useCases.whyNow: Commercial submission volumes are up while underwriting capacity is flat — triage decides which risks you even get to quote.

useCases.title: Claims straight-through processing
useCases.body: Clean claims settled automatically; complex ones assembled and drafted by agents for adjuster judgment — fraud signals woven throughout.
useCases.whyNow: Claims experience is the #1 driver of retention, and settlement speed is the experience.
useCases.impact: Cycle times cut by half or more

useCases.title: Climate & catastrophe analytics
useCases.body: Geospatial and cat-model data fused with portfolio exposure for accumulation control, pricing and climate disclosure.
useCases.whyNow: Secondary perils keep breaking loss records and reinsurers are repricing accordingly — capital costs now track analytics maturity.

useCases.title: Underwriter & agent copilots
useCases.body: Assistants that surface appetite, guidelines, comparable risks and prior decisions inside the underwriting workbench.
useCases.whyNow: A generation of senior underwriters is retiring; their judgment leaves with them unless it is productized.

useCases.title: Subrogation & recovery detection
useCases.body: NLP over claim files that flags missed recovery opportunities and drafts demand packages.
useCases.whyNow: Recovery leakage is pure margin sitting in unstructured claim notes.

faqs.q: How quickly can document intelligence improve our submission flow?
faqs.a: Triage automation on submissions, loss runs and schedules typically shows measurable cycle-time reduction within a quarter — extraction models reach useful accuracy fast, and underwriters feel the difference immediately in how their day starts.

faqs.q: Does claims automation risk our customer relationships?
faqs.a: Done properly it improves them: clean claims settle in hours instead of weeks, and adjusters concentrate on the complex cases where empathy and judgment matter. We instrument satisfaction alongside cycle time so the trade-off is measured, not assumed.

faqs.q: How do you keep AI underwriting explainable for regulators and reinsurers?
faqs.a: Reason codes on every recommendation, documented data lineage, bias monitoring and human authority over the final decision. The underwriting workbench shows its evidence — which underwriters demand anyway before they trust it.

faqs.q: Do clinicians actually adopt ambient documentation?
faqs.a: When it is deployed with clinician champions, tuned to specialty workflows and measured on time returned — yes, faster than any clinical software we have seen. Adoption is led, not mandated; the tool earns its place by giving hours back.

faqs.q: Can you integrate with our EHR?
faqs.a: Yes — we build on FHIR-based integration with the major EHR platforms, working within your vendor's approved integration frameworks and your interface engine standards.

IT and OT are converging into industrial intelligence — predictive quality, asset reliability, supply-chain digital twins and copilots that put decades of tribal knowledge at every operator’s fingertips. We connect the machines, the ERP and the shop floor into platforms that turn industrial data exhaust into uptime, yield and a supply chain that bends without breaking.

useCases.body: Live network models for demand sensing, supplier risk and scenario planning that planners run before committing capital.

faqs.q: Our OT data is messy and siloed. Is predictive maintenance still feasible?

faqs.q: How do you deploy AI on the factory floor without disrupting production?
faqs.a: Shadow-mode first: models run alongside operations, predictions are compared against outcomes, and only proven models graduate to advisory and then automated roles. Production continuity is a design constraint from day one.

faqs.q: What is the realistic payback on industrial AI?
faqs.a: Predictive maintenance and quality programs on well-chosen assets typically pay back within twelve months through downtime and scrap reduction — we scope the first deployment against your loss data so the business case is yours, not an industry average.

faqs.q: How do you use network data without breaching subscriber privacy?

faqs.q: Where does AI pay fastest for an operator?
faqs.a: High-value churn prevention and tier-1 service containment usually pay first — both show results within two quarters. Network optimization compounds larger over time but has a longer data-foundation runway.
